R8.reason: Frame, then rows from bottom to top, then paint and clothes pins, then hang; order possible. Image step 1 shows the two sides meeting at the apex, which is where the hook hangs (image step 9).

evidence.quote: Drill two pocket holes in each end of all the Row pieces - Drill two pocket holes on the 30 degree mitered end of the Right Side.

R9.reason: Pocket holes in 1/2in plywood strips; search of steps/materials/description for /setting|jig|thickness/i finds none; viewed images (step 1, step 9) show no jig setting; step 0 has no image.

evidence.quote: This should be approximately 6" up from the last row.

R14.arithmetic: Rows sit 'where the two ends meet the two Sides' so row length is proportional to distance from the apex: Row 6 = 24 at 48in (Right Side) from the apex, each row 4 shorter = 4/24 x 48 = 8in apart along the side (51in Left Side: 8.5in); five gaps = 40in. The step says 6in up (5 x 6 = 30in), where the sides would be 24 x (48-30)/48... Row 1 would sit 18in from the apex = 9in wide, not the 4in cut.
R14.reason: Stated 6in row spacing is inconsistent with the cut row lengths (4in step per row = about 8in along the sides) so rows cannot both span the sides and sit 6in apart.
